The only charge printed anywhere is 2 g of tembotrione in each of [0055], [0056] and [0057], confirmed against the page images p11 and p12. No product mass, no mole amount, no yield percentage and no assay purity is printed in any of the three examples, in [0021] to [0026], or in claims 8, 9 and 10, confirmed against p08 and p13. With a stated input mass and no stated output, no mass balance and no molar-mass check can close or fail, so the absence of mass_balance_implausible and molar_mass_inconsistent flags is correct and not a missing flag. Nothing was inferred from the 2 g in any record: every product quantity field, product_yield_pct and product_purity_pct is null across all seven records.

The only arithmetic performed anywhere in the artifact is the pressure conversion, and it is exact. 'mindestens 5 bar' at lines 588 and 809 becomes pressure.value_kpa 500.0 in both Preparation - General Process_Step 2 and Claims_Step 2. 5 bar is 500 kPa. Every temperature was checked against its printed line and against the page image. 56°C at line 661 (p11), 78°C and 7°C at line 668 (p12), 111°C and 7°C at line 672 (p12), 'bei Temperaturen < 60°C getrocknet' in all three examples, 0°C to 80°C at lines 578, 580 and 803 (p08 and p13).
